cohort: The study included 309 pregnant women admitted to the Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology JNIMS, Porompat, of whom 8 had twin pregnancies.
finding: Twin pregnancies were associated with adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, including significantly lower period of gestation, higher incidence of preterm delivery, and increased maternal anaemia.
mod_finding: A quarter of twin pregnant mothers required Cesarean section (CS).
gest_age: The period of gestation was significantly lower among twin pregnancies than singleton pregnancies.
